in_marathi.name: Sriyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Abundance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sriyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sri means Goddess Lakshmi, the Goddess of wealth, prosperity, and abundance. Yansh means Jansh or Lord of the Universe, together meaning God of Abundance
